host_guidance.system_only: A verified SYSTEM package may start and serve ordinary dialogue without private MEMORY. Do not create or claim autobiographical recall merely because core operational SQLite exists.
host_guidance.memory_available_separately: When a verified MEMORY package is separately available, prefer run.py memory-converge while the daemon is inactive. The convergence path accepts canonical and generator-v2 transport, performs safe v3 repack when required, attaches atomically, recovers/normalizes, rebuilds wake state as needed, and then evaluates the configured recall readiness policy before restart.
host_guidance.memory_missing: Treat MEMORY as absent_optional in the default mode. Core runtime readiness remains independent; recall and continuity claims remain disabled.
host_guidance.memory_invalid: Keep core runtime available, fail memory readiness closed, and do not use the invalid memory source for recall.
host_guidance.autobiographical_claims: memory_search_ready may be true for transactional-tier-only search. A positive autobiographical memory claim requires full_autobiographical_recall_ready=true plus local MEMORY provenance for the memory items actually used by the turn.

truth_boundary: SYSTEM is executable code plus runtime contracts. MEMORY is mutable private data and may be attached, replaced or absent independently. Operational core state under workspace_runtime/core_state is not autobiographical memory and must never be used as recall evidence. Generic search readiness does not imply native autobiographical recall readiness.
